results.title: Places map
results.checks: On Genesis 12 the Places map pane shows the published Bible lands base map (its tiles drawn) with at least one place marker
results.note: base map with 6 tile(s) drawn, 8 marker(s)

results.title: Places map follows a chapter that arrives late
results.checks: With the Places map open on Deuteronomy 32, move to John 1 while its chapter is slow to arrive: the map draws John 1's places from the publishers (Jerusalem, Bethany beyond the Jordan, Galilee, Beth-Saida, Nazareth), not Deuteronomy's, and marks Bethany beyond the Jordan's site as uncertain
results.note: Deuteronomy 32 drew Bashan,Gomorrah,Sodom,Jordan,Abarim,Canaan,Jericho,Moab,Mount Nebo,Mount Hor (of Edom),Meribah 1,Wilderness of Zin; John 1 drew Alexandria — Valentinians,Lyon (Irenaeus’s opponents) — Valentinians,Rome — Valentinians,Docetic tendencies,Smyrna — Docetic tendencies,Tralles — Docetic tendencies,Rome — Marcionites,Sinope (his home) — Marcionites,Jerusalem,Bethany (Beyond the Jordan),Jordan,Galilee,Beth-Saida,Nazareth; Bethany beyond the Jordan: site uncertain

results.title: A people group's region on the map
results.checks: On Acts 8 the Places map draws the Samaritan believers' region from the published map work beside the Bible places, and tapping it opens the group's picture and summary
results.note: drew 13 places including the Samaritan believers' region

results.title: Places map without its base map
results.checks: When the base map's library cannot be loaded (as in a tab left open across a deploy, where the host answers the app shell for a chunk it no longer has), the Places map on Acts 6 still draws the chapter's places and says under the map that the base map could not be loaded, with Reload
results.note: drew 14 places (14 marker(s)) on a blank map; "The base map could not be loaded, so the places are drawn on…" with Reload
